A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same neural-entropy, mutual-information and diffusion-autoencoder study despite the changed title. Their complete main texts, appendices, equations and figures support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 Section 6 and Appendices E–F report original Gaussian experiments, image entropy estimates, VAE–DAE comparisons and MNIST/CIFAR-10 latent analyses.

after.justification: v4 Section 5 and Appendices D–E retain those original experiments and add Tiny ImageNet entropy results in Figure 16.

M1.justification: The entropy-matching dynamics, training losses, CFG rule and two-latent DAE split at tau are retained. v4 expands the derivation of the existing split loss without establishing a change to the training or inference procedure.

E1.justification: v4 adds Tiny ImageNet, described as 200 classes of 64×64 images, to the image entropy evaluation. Gaussian, MNIST and CIFAR-10 coverage remains; this extends the existing image task rather than introducing a new task or modality.

E2.justification: The Gaussian experiments retain analytic scores and entropies as references. The VAE–DAE comparison retains the Gaussian-likelihood VAE with the same encoder architecture. Newly cited latent-diffusion and distillation methods are not evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The Gaussian flattening experiment changes its reported nonflattened eigenvalue recipe from N(0,1)/sqrt(k) in v3 Appendix E.1 to abs(N(0,1/k)) + 0.1 in v4 Appendix D.1. This corrects the previously signed construction to positive eigenvalues. The retained plots do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The Gaussian flattening/determinism and CFG-weight sweeps, VAE–DAE examples, and split-time/t-SNE latent analyses retain the same questions and plotted evidence. Tiny ImageNet extends the existing entropy evaluation without introducing a separate ablation or robustness test.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. v4's discussion of mutual-information overestimation adds a limitation, without introducing statistical uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: v4 Figure 16 adds Tiny ImageNet neural entropy of 29586.2 nats and estimated mutual information of 9.2868 nats. The corresponding MNIST values, 2017.9 and 4.1, and CIFAR-10 values, 7776.2 and 7.5404, match v3 Figure 14. The other experimental plots and principal findings are retained.

T1.justification: v4 removes the Kelly growth-rate derivation and Appendix C's quantum/operator formulation while retaining the core stochastic-control and mutual-information derivations. Appendix E.3 adds the defined term h(s1,s2) and an explicit two-interval derivation of the split-loss bound, Eqs. (65)–(70), replacing v3 F.3's treatment with implicit constants.

C1.justification: v4 drops the Kelly-optimal-betting connection as a claimed contribution and explicitly foregrounds pixel-space image models. The claims about total correlation, semantic/perceptual separation and CFG were already present in v3's introduction and conclusion, so most substantive claims remain.

C2.justification: v4 adds interpretations concerning latent-diffusion efficiency, loss of fine detail during distillation and renormalization-group analogies, while removing the infinite-autoencoder/quantum interpretation. Figure 16 newly acknowledges that image mutual-information estimates exceed label-entropy bounds and qualifies them as ballpark evidence.

D1.justification: v4 revises the synthetic covariance-generation specification and documents Tiny ImageNet's 200-class, 64×64 configuration. The H200/140 GB hardware disclosure, JAX/Flax framework, model descriptions and embedded GitHub code link remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The gambling and quantum-transition positioning is removed. v4 adds substantive connections to VAE total correlation, learned manifold geometry, latent diffusion, distillation and renormalization, including Gao et al. and Stanczuk et al. The related-work novelty statement is refined around TC–MI interplay in diffusion models and manifold dimensionality.

P1.justification: The title changes from 'Diffusion Models are Kelly Gamblers' to 'On the Separability of Information in Diffusion Models.' The abstract, opening motivation and contribution list are substantially rewritten; the Kelly section and quantum appendix are removed, and the conclusion and document organization are revised.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch to two columns. v4 adds the manifold illustration in Figure 1, redisplays existing CIFAR-10 curves in Figure 3, moves v3 Figure 1 to Figure 9, and expands the entropy-profile figure with Tiny ImageNet. v3's final two illustration figures are removed, with widespread resizing and relocation of retained displays.

improvement.justification: v4 improves focus and explanation through the manifold illustration, corrects the Gaussian eigenvalue recipe, and explicitly qualifies mutual-information estimates that v3 left unqualified. Tiny ImageNet adds supporting breadth. These are limited gains because the central results remain largely unchanged and estimation accuracy is unresolved. The new Figure 16 caveat also contains an arithmetic error: log(200) is about 5.298, not 5.928.
